title: End each workday with a five-minute shutdown ritual.
subtitle: Workday boundary
rationale: Review open loops, park tomorrow's first move, and declare the day closed so work stops leaking into the evening.

evidence.summary: Meta-analytic evidence links psychological detachment from work to recovery, wellbeing, and next-day performance; the specific ritual format is practitioner-designed.

sources.label: Cal Newport on the work shutdown ritual

indications: Work thoughts intrude through evenings and at lights-out.
The day ends by trailing off rather than by decision.
Open loops resurface as 3 a.m. wake-ups.
